build_pt_video_transform: build a video preprocessing transform pipeline for VJEPA2 with specified image size and normalization
run_sample_inference: run end-to-end VJEPA2 inference comparing HuggingFace and PyTorch model outputs on a sample video
load_pretrained_vjepa_pt_weights: load pretrained VJEPA2 encoder weights from a PyTorch checkpoint into a vision transformer model
forward_vjepa_video: forward pass VJEPA2 models on a video to extract patch-wise features from both HuggingFace and PyTorch implementations
get_vjepa_video_classification_results: get top-5 Something-Something V2 classification predictions from VJEPA2 patch features using an attentive classifier
